(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCK VERIFICATION & SIL-3 EMERGENCY TRIP                     *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyTrip THEN
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := TRUE;
    iStateStep := 90; (* Jump directly to STATE_EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_BLOWDOWN *)
END_IF;

(* Operator Diagnostic Reset & Latch Clear Handler *)
IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    IF bEmergencyTrip THEN bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := FALSE; END_IF;
    IF rH2_Concentration_EngineBay_Pct < 15.0 THEN bTrip_H2Leak_Latched := FALSE; END_IF;
    IF (rV_DCBus_Voted_V >= 1300.0) AND (rV_DCBus_Voted_V <= 1750.0) THEN
        bTrip_DCBusOvervoltage_Lat := FALSE;
        bTrip_DCBusUndervoltage_Lat := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF (rV_MinCell_V_1 > 0.58) AND (rV_MinCell_V_2 > 0.58) AND
       (rV_MinCell_V_3 > 0.58) AND (rV_MinCell_V_4 > 0.58) THEN
        bTrip_StackCellReversal_Lat := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF rBESS_MaxCellTemp_DegC < 50.0 THEN bTrip_BESSOvertemp_Lat := FALSE; END_IF;
    IF ABS(rBESS_Current_A) < 1600.0 THEN bTrip_BESSOvercurrent_Lat := FALSE; END_IF;
    IF rH2_Concentration_Exhaust_Pct < 0.80 THEN bTrip_ExhaustH2Flamb_Lat := FALSE; END_IF;
    IF (bHealth_V_ChA OR bHealth_V_ChB OR bHealth_V_ChC) AND
       (bHealth_P_ChA OR bHealth_P_ChB OR bHealth_P_ChC) AND
       (bHealth_Speed_ChA OR bHealth_Speed_ChB OR bHealth_Speed_ChC) THEN
        bTrip_SensorLoss_Lat := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    IF (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_1 < 80.0) AND (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_2 < 80.0) AND
       (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_3 < 80.0) AND (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_4 < 80.0) THEN
        bTrip_CoolantOverheat_Lat := FALSE;
    END_IF;

    IF (wTripAlarmBitmask = 16#0000) AND (iStateStep = 99) THEN
        iStateStep := 0; (* Reset from lockout to idle *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2-OUT-OF-3 (2oo3) TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY VOTING ENGINE                         *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* 2.1: High-Voltage DC Link Bus Voltage 2oo3 Voting *)
IF bHealth_V_ChA AND bHealth_V_ChB AND bHealth_V_ChC THEN
    IF (rV_DCBus_ChA >= rV_DCBus_ChB) THEN
        IF (rV_DCBus_ChB >= rV_DCBus_ChC) THEN
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChB;
        ELSIF (rV_DCBus_ChA >= rV_DCBus_ChC) THEN
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChC;
        ELSE
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rV_DCBus_ChA >= rV_DCBus_ChC) THEN
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChA;
        ELSIF (rV_DCBus_ChB >= rV_DCBus_ChC) THEN
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChC;
        ELSE
            rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rV_DCBus_ChA - rV_DCBus_ChB) > rTOL_V_DCBus_V) OR
       (ABS(rV_DCBus_ChB - rV_DCBus_ChC) > rTOL_V_DCBus_V) OR
       (ABS(rV_DCBus_ChA - rV_DCBus_ChC) > rTOL_V_DCBus_V) THEN
        rTimer_V_Discrepancy := rTimer_V_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_V_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rV_DCBus_ChA - rV_DCBus_Voted_V) > rTOL_V_DCBus_V THEN
                bHealth_V_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rV_DCBus_ChB - rV_DCBus_Voted_V) > rTOL_V_DCBus_V THEN
                bHealth_V_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_V_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_V_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_V_ChA AND bHealth_V_ChB) THEN
    rV_DCBus_Voted_V := 0.5 * (rV_DCBus_ChA + rV_DCBus_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_V_ChA AND bHealth_V_ChC) THEN
    rV_DCBus_Voted_V := 0.5 * (rV_DCBus_ChA + rV_DCBus_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_V_ChB AND bHealth_V_ChC) THEN
    rV_DCBus_Voted_V := 0.5 * (rV_DCBus_ChB + rV_DCBus_ChC);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_V_ChA THEN
        rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_V_ChB THEN
        rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_V_ChC THEN
        rV_DCBus_Voted_V := rV_DCBus_ChC;
    ELSE
        rV_DCBus_Voted_V := 0.0;
        bTrip_SensorLoss_Lat := TRUE;
        bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 2.2: Hydrogen Storage Supply Pressure 2oo3 Voting *)
IF bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB AND bHealth_P_ChC THEN
    IF (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA >= rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB) THEN

            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB;
        ELSIF (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA >= rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA >= rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA;
        ELSIF (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB >= rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC) THEN
            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC;
        ELSE
            rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    IF (ABS(rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA - rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB) > rTOL_P_H2Supply_Bar) OR
       (ABS(rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB - rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC) > rTOL_P_H2Supply_Bar) OR
       (ABS(rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA - rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChC) > rTOL_P_H2Supply_Bar) THEN
        rTimer_P_Discrepancy := rTimer_P_Discrepancy + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF rTimer_P_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA - rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar) > rTOL_P_H2Supply_Bar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB - rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar) > rTOL_P_H2Supply_Bar THEN
                bHealth_P_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_P_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_P_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_P_ChA AND bHealth_P_ChB) THEN
    rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChA + rP_H2Supply_Bar_ChB);
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;

        IF rTimer_PurgePulse_4 >= rPURGE_PULSE_DURATION_SEC THEN
            bPurgeActive_4 := FALSE; bAnodePurgeValveCmd_4 := FALSE;
            rAccumulated_Ah_4 := 0.0; rTimer_PurgeInterval_4 := 0.0; rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_4 := 1.5;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bPurgeActive_4 := FALSE; bAnodePurgeValveCmd_4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: MULTIPHASE INTERLEAVED DC/DC BOOST CONVERTER ACTIVE RIPPLE DAMPING ENGINE          *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bStackIsolated_1 THEN
    rI_Ripple_Est_1 := rI_Stack_A_1 - rI_Stack_Filt_1;
    rTempCalc := (rI_Ripple_Est_1 - (rI_Stack_Prev_1 - rI_Stack_Filt_1)) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rI_Stack_Prev_1 := rI_Stack_A_1;
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 := -1.0 * ((rKp_RippleDamping * rI_Ripple_Est_1) + (rKd_RippleDamping * rTempCalc));
    IF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 > 35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 := 35.0;
    ELSIF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 < -35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 := -35.0; END_IF;
    rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_1 := 0.0;
ELSE
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_1 := 0.0; rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_1 := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF NOT bStackIsolated_2 THEN
    rI_Ripple_Est_2 := rI_Stack_A_2 - rI_Stack_Filt_2;
    rTempCalc := (rI_Ripple_Est_2 - (rI_Stack_Prev_2 - rI_Stack_Filt_2)) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rI_Stack_Prev_2 := rI_Stack_A_2;
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 := -1.0 * ((rKp_RippleDamping * rI_Ripple_Est_2) + (rKd_RippleDamping * rTempCalc));
    IF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 > 35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 := 35.0;
    ELSIF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 < -35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 := -35.0; END_IF;
    rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_2 := 90.0;
ELSE
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_2 := 0.0; rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF NOT bStackIsolated_3 THEN
    rI_Ripple_Est_3 := rI_Stack_A_3 - rI_Stack_Filt_3;
    rTempCalc := (rI_Ripple_Est_3 - (rI_Stack_Prev_3 - rI_Stack_Filt_3)) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rI_Stack_Prev_3 := rI_Stack_A_3;
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 := -1.0 * ((rKp_RippleDamping * rI_Ripple_Est_3) + (rKd_RippleDamping * rTempCalc));
    IF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 > 35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 := 35.0;
    ELSIF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 < -35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 := -35.0; END_IF;
    rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_3 := 180.0;
ELSE
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_3 := 0.0; rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_3 := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF NOT bStackIsolated_4 THEN
    rI_Ripple_Est_4 := rI_Stack_A_4 - rI_Stack_Filt_4;
    rTempCalc := (rI_Ripple_Est_4 - (rI_Stack_Prev_4 - rI_Stack_Filt_4)) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    rI_Stack_Prev_4 := rI_Stack_A_4;
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 := -1.0 * ((rKp_RippleDamping * rI_Ripple_Est_4) + (rKd_RippleDamping * rTempCalc));
    IF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 > 35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 := 35.0;
    ELSIF rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 < -35.0 THEN rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 := -35.0; END_IF;
    rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_4 := 270.0;
ELSE
    rI_RippleDamping_Comp_A_4 := 0.0; rDCDC_InterleavePhase_Deg_4 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER / STATE OBSERVER UPDATE                                    *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rInnovation[1] := (rV_DCBus_Filt_V - 1500.0) - xState_Pred[1];
rInnovation[2] := (rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct - 65.0) - xState_Pred[2];
rInnovation[3] := (rTARGET_LAMBDA_O2 - 2.05) - xState_Pred[3];
rInnovation[4] := (0.25 * (ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_1) + ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_2) + ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_3) + ABS(rI_Ripple_Est_4))) - xState_Pred[5];

FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := xState_Pred[iRow];
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mL_Gain[iRow, iCol] * rInnovation[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Est[iRow] := rAccumulator;
    xState[iRow] := xState_Est[iRow];
END_FOR;

dDisturbance[1] := rP_TractionDemand_Filt_kW;
dDisturbance[2] := rV_TrainSpeed_Filt_Kmh;

FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mA_d[iRow, iCol] * xState_Est[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * uControl[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 2 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mE_d[iRow, iCol] * dDisturbance[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Pred[iRow] := rAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT QP SOLVER               *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF (iStateStep = 50) OR (iStateStep = 60) OR (iStateStep = 70) THEN
    IF xState_Pred[3] < -0.35 THEN
        rStarvationSlack := -0.35 - xState_Pred[3];
    ELSE
        rStarvationSlack := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    IF xState_Pred[2] < -35.0 THEN
        rSOCSlack := -35.0 - xState_Pred[2];
    ELSIF xState_Pred[2] > 20.0 THEN
        rSOCSlack := xState_Pred[2] - 20.0;
    ELSE
        rSOCSlack := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    FOR iQPIteration := 1 TO iMaxQPIterations DO
        rGradJ[1] := (mB_d[1, 1] * vQ_Diag[1] * xState_Pred[1]) +
                     (mB_d[2, 1] * vQ_Diag[2] * xState_Pred[2]) +
                     (mB_d[3, 1] * vQ_Diag[3] * (xState_Pred[3] - (rRhoStarvationPenalty * rStarvationSlack))) +
                     (vR_Diag[1] * uControl[1]);

        rGradJ[2] := (mB_d[1, 2] * vQ_Diag[1] * xState_Pred[1]) +
                     (mB_d[2, 2] * vQ_Diag[2] * (xState_Pred[2] + (rRhoSOCPenalty * rSOCSlack))) +
                     (vR_Diag[2] * uControl[2]);

        rGradJ[3] := (mB_d[4, 3] * vQ_Diag[4] * xState_Pred[4]) +
                     (vR_Diag[3] * uControl[3]);

        rGradJ[4] := (mB_d[5, 4] * 25.0 * xState_Pred[5]) +
                     (vR_Diag[4] * uControl[4]);

        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            uControl[iIdx] := uControl[iIdx] - (rAlphaStep * rGradJ[iIdx]);
        END_FOR;

        IF uControl[1] < -1200.0 THEN uControl[1] := -1200.0; ELSIF uControl[1] > 400.0 THEN uControl[1] := 400.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[2] < -2500.0 THEN uControl[2] := -2500.0; ELSIF uControl[2] > 2500.0 THEN uControl[2] := 2500.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[3] < 0.0 THEN uControl[3] := 0.0; ELSIF uControl[3] > 100.0 THEN uControl[3] := 100.0; END_IF;
        IF uControl[4] < -35.0 THEN uControl[4] := -35.0; ELSIF uControl[4] > 35.0 THEN uControl[4] := 35.0; END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    rTempCalc := rMAX_FC_RAMP_KW_PER_SEC * tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
    IF (uControl[1] - uControl_Prev[1]) > rTempCalc THEN
        uControl[1] := uControl_Prev[1] + rTempCalc;
    ELSIF (uControl_Prev[1] - uControl[1]) > rTempCalc THEN
        uControl[1] := uControl_Prev[1] - rTempCalc;
    END_IF;
    uControl_Prev[1] := uControl[1];
    uControl_Prev[2] := uControl[2];
    uControl_Prev[3] := uControl[3];
    uControl_Prev[4] := uControl[4];
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 9: HEAVY FREIGHT LOCOMOTIVE DYNAMIC BRAKING & REGENERATIVE POWER SPLIT                *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF iMasterNotchCommand > 0 THEN
    IF iMasterNotchCommand > 8 THEN iMasterNotchCommand := 8; END_IF;
    rEffectiveTractionDemand_kW := rNotchPowerTable[iMasterNotchCommand];
    rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW := 0.0;
    rP_DynamicBrakeResistor_kW := 0.0;
    rDynamicBrakeChopperDuty_Pct := 0.0;

    rAccumulator := 1200.0 + uControl[1];
    rTempCalc := rStackCapacityDerateFactor * rTOTAL_FC_RATED_KW;
    IF rAccumulator > rTempCalc THEN rAccumulator := rTempCalc;
    ELSIF rAccumulator < 80.0 THEN rAccumulator := 80.0; END_IF;
    rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW := rAccumulator;

    rP_BESS_Command_kW := (rEffectiveTractionDemand_kW + rP_AuxiliaryLoads_kW) - rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW;
    IF rP_BESS_Command_kW > rBESS_MaxDischargePwr_kW THEN
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := rBESS_MaxDischargePwr_kW;
    ELSIF rP_BESS_Command_kW < (-1.0 * rBESS_MaxChargePwr_kW) THEN
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := -1.0 * rBESS_MaxChargePwr_kW;
    END_IF;

ELSIF iMasterNotchCommand < 0 THEN
    iIdx := -1 * iMasterNotchCommand;
    IF iIdx > 8 THEN iIdx := 8; END_IF;
    rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW := rNotchDynamicBrakeTable[iIdx];
    rEffectiveTractionDemand_kW := -1.0 * rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW;
    rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW := 20.0 * INT_TO_REAL(iOperationalStackCount);

    IF rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW > rP_AuxiliaryLoads_kW THEN
        rAccumulator := rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW - rP_AuxiliaryLoads_kW;
    ELSE
        rAccumulator := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    IF (rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct < 85.0) AND (rBESS_MaxCellTemp_DegC < 52.0) THEN
        IF rAccumulator > rBESS_MaxChargePwr_kW THEN
            rBESS_ChargeAllocated_kW := rBESS_MaxChargePwr_kW;
        ELSE
            rBESS_ChargeAllocated_kW := rAccumulator;
        END_IF;
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := -1.0 * rBESS_ChargeAllocated_kW;
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator - rBESS_ChargeAllocated_kW;
    ELSE
        rBESS_ChargeAllocated_kW := 0.0;
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    IF rAccumulator > rDYNAMIC_BRAKE_RATING_KW THEN
        rDBR_DissipationAllocated_kW := rDYNAMIC_BRAKE_RATING_KW;
    ELSE
        rDBR_DissipationAllocated_kW := rAccumulator;
    END_IF;
    rP_DynamicBrakeResistor_kW := rDBR_DissipationAllocated_kW;
    rDynamicBrakeChopperDuty_Pct := (rP_DynamicBrakeResistor_kW / rDYNAMIC_BRAKE_RATING_KW) * 100.0;

ELSE
    rEffectiveTractionDemand_kW := 0.0;
    rDynamicBrakeDemand_kW := 0.0;
    rP_DynamicBrakeResistor_kW := 0.0;
    rDynamicBrakeChopperDuty_Pct := 0.0;

    IF rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct < 60.0 THEN
        rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW := rP_AuxiliaryLoads_kW + 250.0;
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := -250.0;
    ELSE
        rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW := rP_AuxiliaryLoads_kW;
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

rV_DCBus_Target_V := rNOMINAL_DC_BUS_V;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 10: MULTI-STACK HEALTH EVALUATION, ISOLATION & FAULT TOLERANCE ENGINE                *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rCellVoltageSpread_1 := rV_AvgCell_V_1 - rV_MinCell_V_1;
rCoolantDeltaT_1 := rT_CoolantOut_DegC_1 - rT_CoolantIn_DegC_1;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_1 > 0.095) OR (rV_MinCell_V_1 < 0.52) OR bCVM_CommFault_1 THEN bStackDegraded_1 := TRUE; ELSE bStackDegraded_1 := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_1 > 0.140) OR (rV_MinCell_V_1 < 0.42) OR (rCoolantDeltaT_1 > 18.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_1 > 82.0) THEN
    bStackIsolated_1 := TRUE; bStackContactorEnable_1 := FALSE;
END_IF;

rCellVoltageSpread_2 := rV_AvgCell_V_2 - rV_MinCell_V_2;
rCoolantDeltaT_2 := rT_CoolantOut_DegC_2 - rT_CoolantIn_DegC_2;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_2 > 0.095) OR (rV_MinCell_V_2 < 0.52) OR bCVM_CommFault_2 THEN bStackDegraded_2 := TRUE; ELSE bStackDegraded_2 := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_2 > 0.140) OR (rV_MinCell_V_2 < 0.42) OR (rCoolantDeltaT_2 > 18.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_2 > 82.0) THEN

IF (rCellVoltageSpread_3 > 0.140) OR (rV_MinCell_V_3 < 0.42) OR (rCoolantDeltaT_3 > 18.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_3 > 82.0) THEN

IF (rCellVoltageSpread_4 > 0.095) OR (rV_MinCell_V_4 < 0.52) OR bCVM_CommFault_4 THEN bStackDegraded_4 := TRUE; ELSE bStackDegraded_4 := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rCellVoltageSpread_4 > 0.140) OR (rV_MinCell_V_4 < 0.42) OR (rCoolantDeltaT_4 > 18.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_4 > 82.0) THEN
    bStackIsolated_4 := TRUE; bStackContactorEnable_4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

iOperationalStackCount := 0;
IF NOT bStackIsolated_1 THEN iOperationalStackCount := iOperationalStackCount + 1; END_IF;
IF NOT bStackIsolated_2 THEN iOperationalStackCount := iOperationalStackCount + 1; END_IF;
IF NOT bStackIsolated_3 THEN iOperationalStackCount := iOperationalStackCount + 1; END_IF;
IF NOT bStackIsolated_4 THEN iOperationalStackCount := iOperationalStackCount + 1; END_IF;

rStackCapacityDerateFactor := INT_TO_REAL(iOperationalStackCount) / 4.0;

IF iOperationalStackCount > 0 THEN
    rAccumulator := rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW / INT_TO_REAL(iOperationalStackCount);
    IF NOT bStackIsolated_1 THEN rP_StackDemand_kW_1 := rAccumulator; ELSE rP_StackDemand_kW_1 := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF NOT bStackIsolated_2 THEN rP_StackDemand_kW_2 := rAccumulator; ELSE rP_StackDemand_kW_2 := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF NOT bStackIsolated_3 THEN rP_StackDemand_kW_3 := rAccumulator; ELSE rP_StackDemand_kW_3 := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF NOT bStackIsolated_4 THEN rP_StackDemand_kW_4 := rAccumulator; ELSE rP_StackDemand_kW_4 := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rP_StackDemand_kW_1 := 0.0; rP_StackDemand_kW_2 := 0.0; rP_StackDemand_kW_3 := 0.0; rP_StackDemand_kW_4 := 0.0;
    rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyTrip THEN bTrip_Hardwire_Latched := TRUE; END_IF;
IF rH2_Concentration_EngineBay_Pct > 25.0 THEN bTrip_H2Leak_Latched := TRUE; END_IF;

IF (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_1 > 84.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_2 > 84.0) OR
   (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_3 > 84.0) OR (rT_CoolantOut_DegC_4 > 84.0) THEN

END_IF;

wTripAlarmBitmask.0 := bTrip_Hardwire_Latched;
wTripAlarmBitmask.1 := bTrip_H2Leak_Latched;

wTripAlarmBitmask.3 := bTrip_DCBusUndervoltage_Lat;

wTripAlarmBitmask.5 := bTrip_BESSOvertemp_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.6 := bTrip_BESSOvercurrent_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.7 := bTrip_ExhaustH2Flamb_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.8 := bTrip_SensorLoss_Lat;
wTripAlarmBitmask.9 := bTrip_CoolantOverheat_Lat;

bWarn_H2SupplyLow := (rP_H2Supply_Voted_Bar < 50.0);
bWarn_HighCellSpread := (rCellVoltageSpread_1 > 0.075) OR (rCellVoltageSpread_2 > 0.075) OR

                            (rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_3 > 12.0) OR (rAnode_N2_MoleFraction_4 > 12.0);

bWarn_LowBESS_SOC := (rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct < 35.0);
bWarn_HighBESS_SOC := (rBESS_SOC_Filt_Pct > 85.0);

wWarningAlarmBitmask.5 := bWarn_HighBESS_SOC;

wSensorHealthBitmask.4 := bHealth_P_ChB;
wSensorHealthBitmask.5 := bHealth_P_ChC;

wSensorHealthBitmask.7 := bHealth_Speed_ChB;

wStackHealthBitmask.0 := NOT bStackIsolated_1;
wStackHealthBitmask.1 := NOT bStackIsolated_2;

END_IF;

(* SECTION 12: DETERMINISTIC 10-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) SEQUENCING ENGINE             *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
CASE iStateStep OF
    0: (* STATE 0: COLD IDLE & DORMANT STANDBY *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bTractionPermissive := FALSE;
        bStackContactorEnable_1 := FALSE;
        bStackContactorEnable_2 := FALSE;
        bStackContactorEnable_3 := FALSE;
        bStackContactorEnable_4 := FALSE;
        rAirCompressorSpeed_Rpm_1 := 0.0;
        rAirCompressorSpeed_Rpm_2 := 0.0;
        rAirCompressorSpeed_Rpm_3 := 0.0;
        rAirCompressorSpeed_Rpm_4 := 0.0;
        bAnodePurgeValveCmd_1 := FALSE;
        bAnodePurgeValveCmd_2 := FALSE;
        bAnodePurgeValveCmd_3 := FALSE;
        bAnodePurgeValveCmd_4 := FALSE;
        rP_FC_TotalDemand_kW := 0.0;
        rP_BESS_Command_kW := 0.0;
        rP_DynamicBrakeResistor_kW := 0.0;
        rDynamicBrakeChopperDuty_Pct := 0.0;

        IF bEnable AND bEmergencyTrip AND (wTripAlarmBitmask = 16#0000) THEN
            IF (iRequestedOperatingMode = 1) OR (iRequestedOperatingMode = 3) OR (iRequestedOperatingMode = 4) THEN

                rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
            END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: PRE-CHECK, INSULATION VERIFICATION & N2 PURGE BLANKET *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;

        bSystemReady := FALSE;

        bSystemReady := FALSE;

        IF NOT bStackIsolated_4 THEN bStackContactorEnable_4 := TRUE; END_IF;

        IF (rV_DCBus_Voted_V >= 1420.0) AND (rV_DCBus_Voted_V <= 1580.0) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 2.0) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;

            iStateStep := 90;

    50: (* STATE 50: NORMAL ACTIVE HYBRID TRACTION WITH MULTIVARIABLE MPC & RIPPLE DAMPING *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bTractionPermissive := TRUE;

        IF NOT bStackIsolated_1 THEN bStackContactorEnable_1 := TRUE; END_IF;
        IF NOT bStackIsolated_2 THEN bStackContactorEnable_2 := TRUE; END_IF;
        IF NOT bStackIsolated_3 THEN bStackContactorEnable_3 := TRUE; END_IF;
        IF NOT bStackIsolated_4 THEN bStackContactorEnable_4 := TRUE; END_IF;

        IF iMasterNotchCommand < 0 THEN
            iStateStep := 60;
        ELSIF bDegradedModeActive THEN
            iStateStep := 70;
        ELSIF (NOT bEnable) OR (iRequestedOperatingMode = 0) OR (iRequestedOperatingMode = 6) THEN
            iStateStep := 80;

        ELSIF bDegradedModeActive THEN

        bSystemReady := TRUE;

        bSystemReady := FALSE;

        bStackContactorEnable_2 := FALSE;
        bStackContactorEnable_3 := FALSE;

        bAnodePurgeValveCmd_2 := FALSE;
        bAnodePurgeValveCmd_3 := FALSE;
